mapper.select: SELECT ub.user_id as userId, ub.book_id as bookId, -- 优先使用阅读历史中的章节ID，如果没有则使用书架中记录的 COALESCE(urh.pre_content_id, ub.pre_content_id) as preContentId, bi.work_direction as workDirection, bi.category_id as categoryId, bi.category_name as categoryName, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.last_chapter_id as lastChapterId, bi.last_chapter_name as lastChapterName, bi.last_chapter_update_time as updateTime FROM user_bookshelf ub LEFT JOIN book_info bi ON ub.book_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN user_read_history urh ON ub.user_id = urh.user_id AND ub.book_id = urh.book_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ub.update_time DESC
